diagnosticRuns.method: Lighthouse page API with GL instrumentation

trace.meaning: In this captured task, main-thread Commit waiting coincides with GPU-process work under SwiftShader software rendering.

facts: The initial six-run group regressed relative to baseline and is retained in full raw form locally and compact form in initial-performance.json.
The unchanged asset subsequently scored 92 desktop / TBT 225 ms and 75 mobile / TBT 1001 ms with the original script entry point.
Disabling the GPU shader disk cache still produced 92 desktop / TBT 230.5 ms.
Instrumented mobile rendering executed 116 draw calls, retained a Canvas, removed the SVG fallback, and reported scene settled.
The tested software GL context did not expose KHR_parallel_shader_compile.
The opaque light-field mesh is included in the existing linear and screen compilation passes.
uncertainties: The cause of the initial anomalous group is unresolved; the later runs do not establish shader caching or any other root cause.
Instrumented one-run measurements are diagnostic evidence, not the final three-run medians.
SwiftShader desktop-browser simulation is not real mobile-device GPU coverage.
decision: No source change was justified by a reproducible regression. Preserve the anomaly and run the original unmodified three-desktop/three-mobile procedure again. If it returns, capture that slow run trace before changing shaders.
